notes.title: Jump Kingdom 2024 Edition Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after 4 years, "Jump Kingdom" has received an update. Although the game content has not increased, I think this update is very important for the game, so I have written it as a major update.

[h1] Cloud archiving support [/h1]
Traditionally, games have not provided cloud save functionality, but now this feature is supported

Ah。 Is this a major update?
Of course, the above updates cannot be major updates

[h1] New skill: Super floating [/h1]
From now on, you can use the special ability 'Super floating'
The "Super floating" skill can be used in the game by using keyboard E (or I) and controller B (which needs to be adapted in STEAM)

As described, when using skills, the character's "Jump Jump" will remain invincible for a period of time and the gravity will decrease
The advanced operational technique for this ability is to use the skill at the moment of jumping, allowing the character to jump to higher heights

[img] https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/818420/extras/%E5%9B%A7%E4%B9%8B%E5%9B%BD_-_2024-11-21_10-26-24.gif?t=1732156341[/img]

By using such skills, the difficulty of the levels can be significantly reduced, and you no longer need to strictly follow the designer's ideas in the game. In addition, in the diamond challenge mode, you can also easily obtain golden diamonds

At the same time, some stages have made slight adjustments to the abilities of this competition. Please find out for yourself

In short, based on the developer's own testing, the addition of this system has brought about significant changes to the gameplay, especially in the Diamond Challenge mode. Developers themselves will also try multiple times in a level to see if they can reach a more extreme time.

Alright, that's all for this update. Have a great game!
